block.hubspot.model.title: HubSpot
block.hubspot.model.description: Search, create, update and associate HubSpot CRM records.
block.hubspot.security_hint: The access token stays in the wallet. Nothing is written until Allow writes is enabled; archive also needs Allow archive.
block.hubspot.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.hubspot.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.hubspot.help_enabled: Off by default. While off, no request reaches HubSpot and the wallet is never read.
block.hubspot.help_secret_ref: Wallet reference holding a HubSpot private app access token, or JSON with token. Never the token itself.
block.hubspot.help_object_type: Default CRM object. A request may name another one; the watch always follows this one.
block.hubspot.help_operation: Used when a request gives no operation. Write operations need Allow writes.
block.hubspot.help_allowed_operations: JSON array among ["search", "get", "create", "update", "upsert", "associate", "archive", "list_properties", "watch"]. The default operation is always allowed.
block.hubspot.help_properties: JSON array of internal property names, for example ["email", "firstname"]. Empty returns HubSpot's default properties. Run list_properties to discover custom ones.
block.hubspot.help_read_limit: Upper bound for one search; a request max_records can only lower it. HubSpot stops search paging at 10,000.
block.hubspot.help_allow_writes: Off by default. Required for create, update, upsert, associate and archive.
block.hubspot.help_id_property: Unique property that identifies a record for upsert, such as email for contacts. A request may give its own. Suggestions list standard names only.
block.hubspot.help_max_write_records: Larger requests are refused before any request. Inputs are sent in batches of 100.
block.hubspot.help_allow_delete: Separate switch for archive. HubSpot moves archived records to its recycle bin, where they can be restored for 90 days.
block.hubspot.help_watch: In Active Runtime, poll records of the object modified since the stored cursor and emit them on changed. One Shot polls once per watch request.
block.hubspot.help_watch_interval_sec: At least 60 seconds between two polls of the Run listener.
block.hubspot.label_emit_existing: Emit recent changes on first start
block.hubspot.help_emit_existing: Off: the first start only records the current position. On: records modified in the window below are emitted once, in bounded polls.
block.hubspot.help_existing_since_hours: How far back the first start looks when Emit recent changes is on.
block.hubspot.help_watch_max_items: More changes wait for the next poll; none is skipped.
block.hubspot.help_page_size: limit sent to the HubSpot search API, at most 200. A request may lower it.
block.hubspot.help_max_pages: Pages per search or watch poll; when reached, the result gives after to continue.
block.hubspot.help_timeout_sec: Total time for one request or poll, pages, batches, pacing and retries included.
block.hubspot.help_max_requests_per_10s: Pacing per access token for this process. Private apps get 100 or more per 10 seconds depending on the plan.
block.hubspot.help_max_search_per_sec: Separate pacing for search requests, which HubSpot limits to a few per second per account.
block.hubspot.help_max_retries: Reads retry after HTTP 429, 5xx or a lost connection; writes only after HTTP 429. The daily limit is never retried.
block.hubspot.help_max_retry_wait_sec: A Retry-After or limit window above this value returns rate_limited instead of waiting.
block.hubspot.help_max_request_bytes: Bound for the incoming request and for each JSON body sent to HubSpot.
block.hubspot.help_max_response_bytes: Larger HubSpot responses are refused as protocol errors.
block.hubspot.help_api_base_url: Keep https://api.hubapi.com. Another origin receives the token; plain HTTP only for a loopback test host.
block.hubspot.help_ca_file: Optional absolute PEM file for a privately signed HTTPS origin. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
